headline: Water supply issues halt factory operations in Bronkhorstspruit
summary: Persistent water supply problems in Bronkhorstspruit have forced local factories to cease operations. The disruption highlights critical infrastructure challenges impacting industrial productivity.
why: Reliable utility infrastructure is essential for manufacturing. Disruptions in water supply directly affect output and operational costs for industrial firms.

impacts.name: Manufacturing
impacts.why: Lack of water prevents factory operations, leading to immediate production losses.
